column1: # The package set, and the single source of truth for it.
# BuildNugets.sh packs in this order, the release and pull-request workflows generate their package
# tables from it, the package tests read it, and the device-test runner scripts clear the local
# NuGet cache for every id listed here. Adding a package means adding a row here and a project under
# src/ - nothing else keeps a second copy of the list.
# Rows are in dependency order: a package's deps must already have appeared above it.
# Columns
#   id      the NuGet package id, which is also the directory under src/ and the .csproj name
#   heads   which target-framework families the package ships, across net8, net9 and net10:
#             all     - the platform-neutral asset of each, plus its android and ios heads (nine)
#             mobile  - android and ios heads only (six)
#   deps    other ids in this repository it depends on, comma separated, or -
# DatadogNet.Maui is 'mobile' because Microsoft.Maui.Controls is a workload metapackage with no
# platform-neutral assets - there is nothing to compile a no-op MAUI shim against at any version -
# and net*-windows cannot be built on this repository's runners. See the comment in its .csproj.
# id
DatadogNet
DatadogNet.CrashReporting
DatadogNet.WebView
DatadogNet.Maui
